notes.title: Changelog #2
notes.content:
- Fixed issue which would keep boss doors locked after reset
- Fixed some level geometry issues
- Fixed some texture issues
- Fixed issues with starting a new game after quitting an in-progress game
- Other small fixes and changes

notes.title: Changelog #1
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue that caused playtime and logs-found to not reset if you started a new game after exiting an existing save-file
- Fixed an issue causing some log entries to get cut off on low resolutions
- Various small interface and log entry fixes
